title: Machine Learning-Based Automated Detection and Quantification of Geographic Atrophy and Hypertransmission Defects Using Spectral Domain Optical Coherence Tomography.
summary: Automated deep-learning models used 900 OCT volumes/100,266 scans from 341 AMD patients to detect/segment geographic atrophy. B-scan detection accuracy 91%, area pixel accuracy 94%; en-face detection 82% and measurement 96%, with device-specific differences.
ai_technology: §§2.1–2.12: B-scan/en-face ML segmentation trained against expert-reviewed masks; automated detection and area quantification are the enabling operation.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Automated deep-learning models used 900 OCT volumes/100,266 scans from 341 AMD patients to detect/segment geographic atrophy. B-scan detection accuracy 91%, area pixel accuracy 94%; en-face detection 82% and measurement 96%, with device-specific differences.
evidence.unknown: Performance was evaluated retrospectively on 341 patients and varied by OCT device; no prospective clinical-impact evaluation was reported.
